body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #271 final head 63a9b107 (dotfiles-T86, codex-orchestrate; Codex security seat; diff head 0f43e161 after one revise round with four fix commits): a 158-line bash launcher (the restore logic overruns the 150-line budget, reported as allowed) run from the main checkout root that requires the generated HERDR_AGENTS_ORCHESTRATOR_KIND=codex and takes the interactive Codex args from model-profiles.env (no literal model or profile flags; a test asserts it); takes a private per-repository lock (sha256 of the canonical path) under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/codex-orchestrate/locks/ before reading identities; refuses the Codex name when it is registered at another project in any local team (teams/*/config.json, no pane reads) or when a different Codex identity exists at this checkout; snapshots every exchanged Claude row and every original Codex membership to the private run directory; exchanges the non-worker Claude registrations with project/type-scoped reset.sh, joins the Codex identity to every exchanged team (--team selects only the polled inbox; an existing seat keeps its memberships and added ones are removed on exit), sets turn delivery, and restores the Claude rows and their both delivery on exit/INT/TERM (a failed restore keeps the lock and snapshot); the first prompt is herdr-agents --directive, the operator task and the completion-protocol sentence, piped on stdin to codex … exec -C <repo> -o <private>/<turn>.final.md -, then exec resume --last - per delivered inbox body (poll every 15 s, --timeout default 1800 s exit 124, --max-turns exit 2, ORCHESTRATION-DONE exit 0 only as the final non-blank line); raw prompts, final messages and console output live only in the mode-0700 private run directory, which the launcher refuses to place under the repository, the agmsg store or TMPDIR; the repository file .orchestration/validation/codex-orchestrate-<date>-<n>.md holds non-secret turn status and private paths only; CODEX_ORCHESTRATE_DELIVERY=hook is refused until T87 validates a blocking delivery path. 38 fake-CLI tests cover argv sequence (stdin prompts), exchange and restore, multi-team join and selected-inbox polling, global and local name-collision refusals, lock before identity reads, private recovery files, delivery set/restore, timeout, max-turns, hook refusal, failures; 838 unit tests; shfmt/shellcheck clean; validate-agent-assets ok; CI 13/13 green on 63a9b107; README section with the private-state contract, recovery steps and the team contract. Eleven Codex threads: nine fixed (bb80c633, c3bd7af0 x5, 0f43e161 x3) and two soft dependencies by design (--directive = T85 on the base; orchestrator-kind rendering = T84, PR #272), all resolved by the orchestrator after confirming ancestry. Live run is T87.
